title: Ticket API fails after backward-incompatible PostgreSQL schema migration
customer_impact: Ticket-list requests return HTTP 500 after a database migration even though API readiness and PostgreSQL connectivity remain healthy.
scope: The deployed API still expects tickets.processing_status, while the newly applied schema exposes the same data under tickets.job_state. PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, and API readiness remain available; the failure is isolated to the application/schema contract.

timeline.event: Post-change validation detected HTTP 500 from /api/tickets while /health/ready remained HTTP 200.
L2 acknowledged the incident and confirmed PostgreSQL remained reachable with SELECT 1.
Schema-contract validation failed because tickets.processing_status was missing; information_schema showed tickets.job_state instead.
API logs confirmed the running application still queried processing_status, proving a release/schema compatibility mismatch.
Pre-change and post-change ticket row count/fingerprint matched, proving the migration was metadata-only and data-preserving.
Approved simulated schema rollback restored processing_status; schema contract and /api/tickets returned healthy and the data fingerprint remained unchanged.

evidence: API readiness remained HTTP 200 during the incident
information_schema showed tickets.job_state present and processing_status absent
API logs contained the missing processing_status database error
ticket row count and deterministic data fingerprint were unchanged by the rename
rollback restored processing_status and removed job_state
post-recovery schema contract passed and /api/tickets returned HTTP 200
post-recovery ticket fingerprint matched the baseline
resolution: L2 proved the incident was a backward-incompatible schema/application mismatch rather than a PostgreSQL outage. Because the migration was a reversible metadata-only rename and ticket data fingerprint was unchanged, the approved simulated rollback restored the previous column contract. Customer-path and data-integrity validation then passed.
